author: Vox
description:
Don’t call it a blue wave. Maryland Gov. Wes Moore sits down with Vox’s Astead Herndon to explain why the midterms proved that the party's future belongs to a mobilized multiracial coalition—and why moving fast on costs matters more than anything else. 

Plus, we look back at America, Actually’s midterm study guide to unpack what lessons we can learn from the election results on the issues that matter most.

America, Actually publishes video episodes every Saturday tackling key issues in politics, culture, and the economy. Subscribe to Vox’s YouTube channel to get them. Listen to episodes of America, Actually on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or your favorite app.

author: Vox
description:
Maryland Gov. Wes Moore never wants anyone to be “the nation’s only Black governor” again. Speaking with Vox’s Astead Herndon, Moore shares how a conversation with former Massachusetts Gov. Deval Patrick shaped his commitment to helping elect more Black governors — and why representation matters.
